lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p41 - Listen, repeat and count.

details: Listen and Repeat checks understanding of numbers and sound. Count practises first-step pronunciation and number sequence
Look for careful listening, accurate repetition, clear sounds, and confident repetition.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p41 - Trace, count and match.

details: Trace develops fine motor skills and eye-hand co-ordination using numbers 8 9 10. Count and Match consolidates their counting understanding  by matching specific information with lines.
Look for good pencil grips,clear and accurate lines on images as well as accurate matching and good pronunciation.
